title: Reliability, Verification & Startup Hardening
headline: SwitchControl 1.3.1 makes entitlement changes safer, keeps Windows network state synchronized, and prevents startup flows from colliding.
changes: Prevented cached or grace entitlement data and delayed expiry timers from triggering premium reverts without fresh cloud verification
Made Network Throttling Index authoritative to live Windows state, with confirmed slider and toggle synchronization across both Tweaks surfaces
Kept missing, busy, and failed native reads inconclusive instead of presenting stale cache values as verified Windows settings
Prevented tours, onboarding, promotions, patch notes, device-lock UI, and mode transitions from overlapping during startup and revert flows
Added regression coverage for entitlement races, native hydration precedence, cross-surface synchronization, and overlay arbitration
